answers.q1: Go modules (go.mod, module github.com/spf13/cobra, go 1.15); the Makefile wraps the Go toolchain. Install dependencies with: make install_deps (which runs: go get -v ./...)
answers.q3: go test -v ./doc -run '^(TestGenMdDoc|TestGenMdDocWithNoLongOrSynopsis|TestGenMdNoHiddenParents|TestGenMdNoTag|TestGenMdTree)$'  (Go has no per-file test filter; this runs the test functions defined in doc/md_docs_test.go, all in package doc. Running go test -v ./doc runs the whole package, including the other doc/*_test.go files.)
answers.q4: golangci-lint run --verbose && docker run -v $(pwd):/wrk -w /wrk ghcr.io/google/addlicense -c 'The Cobra Authors' -y '2013-2023' -l apache -ignore '.github/**' -check .  (the first command is CI's golangci-lint job, which also runs the gofmt and goimports formatters configured in .golangci.yml; the second is CI's lic-headers job. Local equivalent of the Makefile format check: make fmt)
answers.q5: go.sum is a generated lockfile and must not be edited by hand (AGENTS.md says so). There is no vendor/ directory in this repo. Nothing else is marked as generated or vendored.
